about: Lead times and price references of fabrication services that have no shop profile in mechloop/shops/ (SendCutSend and Xometry carry theirs in their profile's lead_time). Every figure is from the owner's agent's benchmark quote pages of 2026-11-19 (reference_parts/batch01/results/web_benchmark_2026-11-19.csv); business days counted from the quote date Thu 2026-11-19. 'delivered' = the figure includes shipping; otherwise shipping_business_days is added (its basis is stated). Owner decision 2026-11-20: no owner 3D printer for Build 1; printed parts (PETG) are ordered from a print service, default Craftcloud.
